evidence_frontier.observation: Exp021 evaluated two compressed variants of Alpha5 on ECG200: w8 (4,278 parameters) achieved 887 aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions out of 1000, while the w16 control achieved 897 correct. The w8 candidate was 10 predictions worse than control, meeting the preregistered retain_alpha5 gate but not exceeding it.
evidence_frontier.hypothesis: A narrower local representation (w8) can consistently reproduce performance within ten correct predictions of the w16 control when evaluated on an independent seed set.

analysis: The prior discovery (Exp021) used a single seed set and reported a 10‑prediction gap between w8 and w16. To confirm reproducibility we must test the same w8 boundary on a fresh, preregistered seed set and compare directly against the unchanged w16 control on that same data. The integer‑count gate avoids floating‑point averaging and aligns with the next preregistered question.
hypothesis: When evaluated on a fresh seed set, the w8 compression will achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions no more than ten fewer than the w16 control on ECG200.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does the w8 local‑width compression retain performance within ten correct predictions of the Alpha5 w16 control on a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 showed a marginal 10‑prediction deficit for w8 versus w16 on a single seed set. Confirming this boundary with an independent seed set is essential before considering further width reductions, ensuring that the observed gap is not a stochastic artifact.

procedure: Generate a fresh preregistered set of N random seeds (e.g., N=5) distinct from those used in Exp021.
For each seed, train the Alpha5 architecture with the specified local_width (8 or 16) on the ECG200 training split (100 samples).
Evaluate each trained model on the ECG200 test split (100 samples) and record the number of correct Q.ANT predictions per seed.
Aggregate correct counts across all seeds for each width to obtain total_correct_w8 and total_correct_w16.
Compare totals using the integer‑count gate: total_correct_w8 ≥ total_correct_w16 − 10.

success_criteria.description: The w8 candidate must achieve at least total_correct_w16 minus ten correct predictions on the combined fresh seed set.

risks.computational_variability: Training on a small ECG200 dataset may exhibit high variance; using multiple seeds mitigates this but does not eliminate stochastic effects.
risks.overfitting: With limited training data, the w8 model could overfit to particular seeds, inflating performance; careful seed selection and aggregation are required.
